Quantum 1.45.0 was certified on 2026-11-16. It pins **nucleus v1.36.0**, **quark v1.19.1** and **orbit v1.22.0**, with 30 sibling modules.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.44.0: nucleus goes from v1.35.0 to v1.36.0 (minor), quark goes from v1.19.0 to v1.19.1 (patch) and orbit goes from v1.21.3 to v1.22.0 (minor). 27 sibling modules change version.
